answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Registered technical writer manual file with technical writers standing, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 14 minutes once; the operator of 729 fakes spends 10206 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. A jade of doubt is healthy, a reef of proof is required, and a nectar of patience is the price of a clean panel. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
